statement: Build a single-file website for SmileCare Dental Clinic in Pune that lets patients request appointments, see services with starting-from prices, read dentist profiles, find the emergency dental contact, read patient FAQs, and switch to a Marathi version.
audience: Patients and prospective patients of the clinic in Pune, reading in English or Marathi.
standards: Plain HTML, CSS and JavaScript in one file; CDN libraries allowed; no build step and no backend.
Every section is available in both English and Marathi with full parity.
Any price, phone number, dentist detail or emergency hour not yet supplied is shown as a visibly marked placeholder, never as a plausible real value.
Prices are never presented as exact or final.
rules: Booking is a request form that opens a pre-filled WhatsApp message or email to the clinic; the page states that the clinic will confirm by phone and does not imply an instant confirmation.
Prices are shown as 'starting from' ranges with a line that the final cost is confirmed after examination.
The Marathi version is drafted by the department and labelled 'pending native review'.
Facts only the clinic holds are tracked as open inputs and shown as marked placeholders; they do not block done.
No data is stored or sent anywhere other than the patient's own WhatsApp or email app.
done_when: The site is one HTML file with inline or CDN-linked CSS and JavaScript, needs no build step, and contains no backend calls.

A booking section contains a request form whose submit opens a pre-filled WhatsApp message or email addressed to the clinic, and the section states that the clinic will confirm the appointment by phone.
A services section lists each service with a 'starting from' price range and a line stating that the final cost is confirmed after examination.
A dentist profiles section shows at least one profile, and every detail not supplied is a visibly marked placeholder.
An emergency dental contact is visible on the page, and the phone number and hours, if not supplied, are visibly marked placeholders.
A patient FAQ section is present with at least one question and answer.

A language toggle switches every section, including the booking form, services, dentist profiles, emergency contact and FAQs, between English and Marathi, and the Marathi view shows a 'pending native review' label.
Every price, phone number, WhatsApp number, email address, dentist detail and emergency hour not yet supplied appears as a visibly marked placeholder in both languages.
open_inputs: Real 'starting from' price ranges for each service
Real dentist names, qualifications and profile details
Clinic phone number, WhatsApp number and email address for booking requests
Emergency contact number and emergency hours
Review of the Marathi text by the Requester or a named Marathi speaker
